audit.whatIsWrong: Stored chart is Skill / Renekton / Renekton / Skill / Skill / Renekton / Renekton in both layers. The mirror moved Level 6 to Renekton and 2+ items to Skill on both of its layers, landing on packet.levelChart: Skill / Renekton / Renekton / Skill / Renekton / Skill / Skill. Rows 4, 5 and 6 disagree.
audit.why: This page's whys already say the mirror's version — whys[4] 'Dominus gives him the health and tankiness to win an even Cyclone all-in', whys[5] 'First item is even', whys[6] 'Two-plus items is skill-based'. Three rows contradicted the sentence printed under them.
audit.corrected: Flipped row 4 to Renekton and rows 5 and 6 to Skill in BOTH layers as one atomic paired group, with row 4's rating to 3/10; rows 5 and 6 already sat at 5/10, which fits Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Fury spike is described as something you wait out — 'only step up when it's empty', 'Trade only when his fury bar is empty'. What the page never says is that Reign of Anger generates Fury FASTER WHEN HE IS LOW ON LIFE.
audit.why: It inverts the finishing sequence. The Renekton you have just chunked refills his bar quicker than the healthy one, so the empty bar you stepped up to punish can be back to 50 before your combo ends. The window is smaller the more you are winning, which is exactly the moment the page tells you to relax.
audit.corrected: Wrote the low-life Fury acceleration into the level 3-5 spike and the don'ts, and gave Dominus its 120/100/80s cooldown plus the fact that it generates Fury periodically on its own.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (a) The stun is attributed to the wrong ability twice: spikes[0] says 'with full fury he double-Cull (W) stuns' and early says 'dodge his Cull (W) empowered auto'. Cull the Meek is his Q — a 325-range spin on a flat 7s that HEALS him. The stun is Ruthless Predator (W), 300 range, 16/14/12/10/8s. (b) The most important property of the empowered W is missing entirely: above 50 Fury it slashes THREE times, stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s, AND DESTROYS DAMAGE SHIELDS ON THE TARGET.
audit.why: The shield destruction is the single highest-value fact in this matchup and it is not on the page anywhere. Sterak's Gage is in this page's own core build, and an empowered Ruthless Predator deletes it outright — so the item that is supposed to save the all-in does nothing in the exact fight it was bought for. Doubling the stun from 0.75 to 1.5 seconds also changes whether the clone can get you out.
audit.corrected: Moved the stun to Ruthless Predator with its real 16s rank-1 cooldown and both stun durations, wrote the shield destruction into the spikes and the cooldown breakdown, and named Cull the Meek correctly as the healing spin on 7s. Slice and Dice given its 450 range, 16s rank-1 cooldown and the armor reduction on the empowered cast.
sources: enemyKit Q/W/E text, ranges and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is headed 'Get empowered-W stunned' but its body is unrelated boilerplate, and no cooldown number appears anywhere despite Ruthless Predator being named as matchup-defining in six fields.
audit.why: 16 seconds at rank 1 down to 8 at rank 5 is the clock the lane runs on, and the player was never given it.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the don'ts, the do's, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.why: The early Executioner's Calling line is earned: Cull the Meek heals him on every cast at 325 range on a flat 7 seconds, and heals for more above 50 Fury.
sources: enemyKit Q text and heal flag

notes: The empowered Ruthless Predator destroying damage shields is the fact worth the whole file: this page's own core build lists Sterak's Gage, and an above-50-Fury W deletes it in the exact all-in it was bought to survive. Nothing on the page said so. Second, the stun was attributed to Cull the Meek (his Q, a healing spin) in two fields. Third, Reign of Anger fills FASTER when he is low, which quietly undermines the page's central instruction to wait for an empty bar — the advice still holds, the window is just shorter than a player would assume. Not asserted because the data cannot settle it: whether Ruthless Predator's shield destruction also removes Warrior Trickster's clone or only damage shields, whether the 1.5s stun is cleansable or reduced by tenacity, and whether Cyclone's knockup can interrupt Slice and Dice mid-dash. Note packet.games is 567 while the brief header says 2970. packet.defects also flags that Wukong wins 53.62% while the chart gives Renekton three stages to Wukong's zero — the chart here is Skill-heavy rather than Wukong-heavy, which a human may want to revisit across both directions together.
